messages:
marta: quick QA — spotted a mismatch between the model catalog entry and the support matrix for NebulaX4B embeddings/limits. catalog shows embed supported, matrix shows blank. https://github.com/redwoodinference/docs/pull/834 :eyes:

benji: thanks — can you paste the two lines/paths? I can patch the YAML quickly if it's just a missing row.

marta: sure, catalog card: docs/models/nebulax4b.md -> contains `embeddings: true` and `max_sequence: 4096`. support matrix path: docs/data/support_matrix.yaml. current matrix has a comment placeholder where the row should be.

benji: ok i'll open a tiny PR. plan: add row in docs/data/support_matrix.yaml and update the model index link. working branch `fix/support-matrix-nebulax4b`.

ashley: fyi, if you change the matrix please also update the SDK example under `docs/examples/embeddings/README.md` — the snippet assumes embed support for NebulaX4B and the example tests fail in CI otherwise.

benji: good call. i'll run the example locally. quick snippet i'll add to the matrix (so we don't forget):

```
# support_matrix.yaml (excerpt)
- model: NebulaX4B
  generate: true
  embeddings: true
  max_sequence: 4096
  notes: "embed tested with v1.2 models; quantized profile recommended"
```

kai: @benji i ran microbenchmarks yesterday — embedding latency is ~12ms/token on 80-token batches on p4d. Throughput numbers are in the bench run: https://benchmarks.redwood/nebula/2026-03-18. Sequence ceiling 4096 is safe. If you want, i can attach a short bench link in the PR.

benji: please do, that helps docs QA. i'll also add a short compatibility note: `requires embed-quant-profile: medium` to avoid misleading customers about CPU fallbacks.

docs-bot: CI | build-docs — failed on `docs/examples/embeddings/README.md` (integration tests), 1 error. See logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/12345

marta: that CI failure was the one i hit earlier. looks like the example uses `client.embed("NebulaX4B", ...)` and test harness defaults to older manifest. changing the support_matrix should unblock it.

benji: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwoodinference/docs/pull/842 — includes matrix row, README snippet tweak, and added bench link and short note under model card. requesting review from @ashley @kai.

ashley: reviewing now, small nit: canonical model name in the examples should be `nebulax-4b` (lowercase dash) to match SDK naming. can you standardize names across card + matrix?

benji: yep will normalize to `nebulax-4b` everywhere. updating branch.

kai: lgtm, bench link added, numbers look consistent. also added a short paragraph about how quant profiles affect embed quality.

marta: awesome — once merged i'll run the docs CI again and close the ticket. thanks all :thumbsup:

benji: merging after one more quick review. tagging release notes: docs: support matrix + nebulax embedding fix.

docs-bot: CI | build-docs — success (after merge).

marta: verified on staging, example passes. closing thread.
